targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status = 'succeeded';
SELECT count(*) FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status = 'failed';
SELECT count(*) FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status IN ('running', 'queued', 'pending');

SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE orchestration_status = 'succeeded') / count(*), 1) END FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status IN ('succeeded', 'failed');
SELECT COALESCE(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))), 0)::int FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status = 'succeeded';
SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, orchestration_status::text AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM reconstructions WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '6 months' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Reconstruction Duration Distribution (seconds)
panels.description: Histogram of reconstruction durations for succeeded reconstructions

targets.rawSql: WITH durations AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)) AS dur FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status = 'succeeded' AND updated_at > created_at), buckets AS (SELECT width_bucket(dur, 0, GREATEST((SELECT max(dur) FROM durations), 1), 10) AS bucket, count(*) AS cnt FROM durations GROUP BY 1) SELECT (bucket - 1) * (GREATEST((SELECT max(dur) FROM durations), 1) / 10)::int || '-' || bucket * (GREATEST((SELECT max(dur) FROM durations), 1) / 10)::int || 's' AS "Duration Range", cnt AS "Count" FROM buckets ORDER BY bucket;

panels.title: Reconstructions by Capture Session
panels.description: Number of reconstruction attempts per capture session, grouped by outcome

targets.rawSql: SELECT cs.name AS capture_session, cs.device_type::text AS device, count(*) AS total_reconstructions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.orchestration_status = 'succeeded') AS succeeded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.orchestration_status = 'failed') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.orchestration_status IN ('queued', 'pending', 'running')) AS in_progress, min(r.created_at) AS first_attempt, max(r.updated_at) AS last_activity FROM reconstructions r JOIN capture_sessions cs ON cs.id = r.capture_session_id GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name, cs.device_type ORDER BY max(r.updated_at) DESC;
SELECT device_type::text AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM capture_sessions GROUP BY 1;

panels.title: Reconstruction Attempts per Capture
panels.description: Distribution of how many reconstruction attempts each capture session has

targets.rawSql: WITH attempts AS (SELECT capture_session_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM reconstructions GROUP BY 1) SELECT cnt || ' attempts' AS "Attempts", count(*) AS "Capture Sessions" FROM attempts GROUP BY cnt ORDER BY cnt;

panels.title: Capture Sessions Without Successful Reconstruction
panels.description: Capture sessions that have never had a successful reconstruction

targets.rawSql: SELECT cs.name, cs.device_type::text AS device, cs.created_at, count(r.id) AS attempts, count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.orchestration_status = 'failed') AS failures FROM capture_sessions cs LEFT JOIN reconstructions r ON r.capture_session_id = cs.id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reconstructions r2 WHERE r2.capture_session_id = cs.id AND r2.orchestration_status = 'succeeded') GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name, cs.device_type, cs.created_at ORDER BY cs.created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT date_trunc('day', updated_at) AS time, orchestration_status::text AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND updated_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Reconstruction Duration Trend
panels.description: Duration of succeeded reconstructions over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT updated_at AS time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))::int AS "duration" FROM reconstructions WHERE orchestration_status = 'succeeded' AND updated_at > created_at ORDER BY updated_at;

SELECT COALESCE(u.name, t.id::text) AS tenant, count(DISTINCT cs.id) AS capture_sessions, count(r.id) AS reconstructions, count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.orchestration_status = 'succeeded') AS succeeded, count(DISTINCT lm.id) AS maps FROM auth.tenants t LEFT JOIN auth.memberships m ON m.tenant_id = t.id AND m.is_personal LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN capture_sessions cs ON cs.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN reconstructions r ON r.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN localization_maps lm ON lm.tenant_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, u.name ORDER BY count(r.id) DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('week', r.created_at) AS time, COALESCE(u.name, r.tenant_id::text) AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM reconstructions r LEFT JOIN auth.memberships m ON m.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND m.is_personal LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE r.created_at >= now() - interval '3 months' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
